purpose: Distinguish user-confirmed degraded binders from non-degraded binders using MD contact graphs only
model: Original MD GAT backbone + two normalized E2 graph scalars before classifier head
comparison_to_previous_run: Versus md_weighted_v1, add two audited E2 geometry descriptors and expand classifier first layer by two inputs. Same eight MD targets, labels, fold-local class weights and fixed training schedule; paired role controls use identical scalar values.
class_weights_fitted_on: Seven training targets only, excluding held-out target
pos_weight_3_not_used: With degrader=1 this would upweight positives; explicit balanced sample weights emphasize the minority negative class instead.
E2_normalization: Training-fold mean/std only; population std; zero-variance scale1. No missing primary-target features allowed.
E2_definition: Ligand-connected coherent images; mean minimum distance over all frames/poses, within-pose paired true-VHL heavy-contact reach80 contrast averaged over paired-state poses. Same descriptors for both role graphs.
prediction_only_policy: Corrected E2 descriptors for extension targets are unavailable; do not fabricate zero scalars or claim extension predictions.
